descriptionChirho: To turn one's body around or toward someone, a physical reorientation of direction or gaze.
To turn or redirect something transitive, including commanding someone to turn or the act of converting/changing the direction of an object or person.
To return something to its owner, to give back what was received.
To turn back or return in a moral, spiritual, or metaphorical sense, often implying repentance or reversion to a former state.
